newsitem.title: USA: Oregon 1997-99 budget revs estimated at $8.2 bln.
newsitem.headline: Oregon 1997-99 budget revs estimated at $8.2 bln.

text.p: Oregon general fund revenues in the 1997-1999 biennium are projected to reach $8.167 billion, state budget officials said Friday.
The state Office of Economic Analysis, in its March revenue report, said overall general fund resources are forecast to be $85.3 million higher than the December 1997-1999 projection.
General fund revenue growth is expected to slow to 9.5 percent in the 1997-1999 biennium, down from an estimated 14.2 percent in 1995-1997.
The Office of Economic Analysis said the projected drop reflects expectations of slower economic growth and changes in state tax laws.
Lottery revenues are forecast to total $559.4 million for the biennium, up $2.4 million from the December projection.
